usability_reason: The response is polite and clearly summarizes the symptom and suspected cause, and it avoids claiming unperformed fixes. However, actionability is weak: the customer explicitly asked for concrete steps or a replacement part to swap this weekend, but the reply only says engineering will review and contact them in 1-2 business days with no interim troubleshooting or part guidance. It also introduces details (battery reads 7%, power-on/disconnect log, RSSI, firmware) not present in the session record, which are unsupported claims relative to what the customer reported.
